title: Universal Esp Script
features:
💎 KESICI HUB V1 - Premium Universal ESP
Kesici Hub V1 is a modern, universal ESP infrastructure specifically developed to work flawlessly across the Roblox platform. With its sleek, transparent "Glass" design and high-performance drawing engine, it elevates your gaming experience to a professional tier.

Key Features:

Universal Integration: Say goodbye to searching for game-specific scripts. Thanks to its dynamic core engine, it works instantly across popular FPS and action games like Arsenal, Phantom Forces, Rivals, and many more.

Broad Executor Support: Highly optimized and fully compatible with all major executors (Xeno, Solara, Delta, Codex, Arceus X, etc.) that support the standard Drawing API.

Advanced ESP Engine: Track your opponents clearly through walls. Fully equipped with Box, Name, and Distance ESP, alongside a highly accurate Skeleton ESP that perfectly supports both R15 and R6 character models.

Flawless Team Check: Our intelligent 3-tier filtering algorithm (Team, TeamColor, Value) perfectly distinguishes your teammates, eliminating unnecessary on-screen clutter and preventing friendly fire confusion.

Customizable Premium UI: Tailor the menu to your exact preferences. Features include adjustable UI transparency (Opacity) for an unobtrusive "glass" look and fully customizable RGB color settings for all visual elements.

High Performance: Built on an optimized framework to ensure a buttery-smooth experience with zero FPS drops. You can easily toggle the menu using the default Right Shift key or assign a custom keybind on the fly.
